podcast.body: The second single from "Like a Prayer," this song was famously reinvented by producer Shep Pettibone from a horn-inflected Latin jam into a sleek, throbbing house music anthem. The remixed version, heard in its multi-million dollar music video (directed by David Fincher as an homage to Fritz Lang's "Metropolis"), became the standard radio version. Madonna was "ahead of the curve" by bringing a house beat to Top 40 radio before a wider wave of house singles crossed over later in 1989. The combination of the original and remix pushed the song to number two on the Hot 100 by July. "its second single, Express Yourself. Was reinvented by producer Shep Pettybone from a horn-inflected Latin flavor jam into a sleek, throbbing house music anthem."
